description: PG1 Sovereign Threat Intelligence: ONE call before an agent acts. Give the action you are about to take and its target; PG1 runs every relevant check in parallel and returns one decision: no_flags, flagged or unknown, with merged reasons, per-check results and latency. no_flags means no flags found in the checks run, never "safe". Fail closed: any check that does not finish makes the decision unknown, never no_flags. Actions: pay (a wallet address: sanctions + wallet age; or an https x402 URL: the endpoint's payTo sanctions and age, network/asset sanity, TLS, domain age), open (a URL or hostname: phishing/look-alike reputation + domain age), install (a package: give ecosystem npm or pypi; target name or name@version), patch (a CVE id, or "vendor product version"), trust_agent (an agent's URL or domain: its A2A agent card, domain age and reputation). Payment: $0.01 via x402 (params._meta["x402/payment"]) or a Gumroad licence key, after 5 free calls a day per caller shared with every other paid tool. Results are signed (see verify_result).
